inj.note: Noel was forced out of this past Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants after going down with the toe injury with just under nine minutes remaining in the fourth quarter. The loss of Noel is a major blow to the Texans, as he had been serving as the team's top return man in addition to emerging as a big-play threat on offense. Through Houston's first seven games, Noel had recorded 19 receptions for a team-leading 331 yards and two touchdowns and added 26 yards on four carries.
inj.label: Out for season

news.h: Texans put WR Jaylin Noel on IR with expected season-ending turf toe injury
news.d: The Texans placed wide receiver Jaylin Noel on injured reserve; he is expected to miss the rest of the season with turf toe, a source confirmed.
